title: Introduce sidecar performance manifests and atomic rollback metadata for model onboarding
creator: Avery Chen
description: Problem: New model variants are published with a single centralized metadata blob. We frequently need richer, runtime-focused guidance (batching hints, KV-cache footprint, quantization profiles) and a safe, auditable way to revert a pinned variant when a regression is detected. This ticket adds a lightweight 'sidecar' performance manifest that travels with model manifests and an atomic rollback metadata record that can be applied by the pinning service and surfaced in the Console docs. This work touches the ingest pipeline, catalog schema, pinning API, and docs.
acceptance_criteria: Schema: sidecar_manifest v1 defined and stored as a sibling object to existing model manifest and retrievable via catalog API
Pinning API: When pinning a variant, an atomic rollback record is written with prior variant hash + human reason and stored in versioned journal

Console: Console shows sidecar fields (preferred_batch_window_ms, kv_cache_estimate_tokens, quantization_profile, fallback_model_variant) in model detail page and a visible "Rollback" history for pins
Ingest: Ingest pipeline validates sidecar manifest fields and rejects if required fields missing for quantized models
End-to-end test: Canary publish -> traffic test -> simulated regression -> automated rollback trigger path exercises writing rollback metadata and console/metrics update
tasks: Design sidecar_manifest v1 schema and add JSON Schema + example manifest (Avery)
Extend ingest validator to accept sidecar_manifest and run field-level checks (ENG)
Update model-catalog storage layer to atomically write manifest + sidecar and to store rollback journal entries (ENG)
Enhance pinning service to write rollback metadata atomically and expose a rollback endpoint guarded by policy (Sofia)
Console UI: add sidecar fields to model page, show rollback journal table, add 'View manifest' modal (Design + FE)
Docs: update onboarding docs with new fields and examples, add migration notes for older manifests (Docs)
End-to-end tests: add integration tests for publish/pin/rollback flow and a regression simulation test (QA)
Create a lightweight migration script to backfill sidecar defaults for recent models (<90 days) if missing (ENG ops)
Security review: quick checklist to confirm no secrets in sidecar and manifests are signed (Security)
Publish GH PRs and playbook snippets for on-call to trigger manual rollback when automated flow fails (ENG + SRE)
decisions: Use a sibling 'sidecar_manifest' object instead of expanding the main manifest to keep runtime hints optional and easily ignored by older services
Sidecar manifest will be content-signed using existing catalog signing keys; store signature as 'sidecar_signature' to verify integrity
Rollback journal will store only references (variant_hash, timestamp, actor, reason) to keep entries small and auditable, with full manifest retrieval via existing APIs

Use a small, explicit field set for v1: {sidecar_manifest_version, preferred_batch_window_ms, kv_cache_estimate_tokens, quantization_profile, fallback_model_variant, perf_profile_id} — additional fields can be added in later versions
Automated rollback triggers will be subscription-based (alerts from perf-regressions), but manual rollback requires two-person approval if model is pinned for >24 hours
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Sidecar manifests become a vector for leaking internal tuning notes. Mitigation: block any fields that look like secrets during ingestion and require signing.
Risk: Backwards compatibility — older runtime/serving components ignore sidecars. Mitigation: make sidecar optional and maintain default fallback behavior in runtime variant selection.
Risk: Large rollback journals increasing storage. Mitigation: journal stores only references and we rotate/archive entries older than 1 year to cheaper tier.
Risk: Mistaken automated rollback due to noisy alerts. Mitigation: require multi-metric confirmation and add cooldown window before automatic rollback.
testing_plan: Unit tests for sidecar JSON Schema validation and signature verification
Integration test: ingest sample model + sidecar -> pin variant -> simulate perf regression event -> ensure rollback metadata written and previous variant re-pinned
E2E flow: Console shows sidecar fields, rollback history updates, and on-call runbook entries are created
Load test: publish 500 sidecar manifests in a batch to ensure ingest latency impact is <200ms per manifest on probe cluster
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary, 72h): Enable sidecar ingestion and pinning on canary account only; monitor ingest latency and dashboarded errors
Phase 2 (beta, 2 weeks): Opt-in for 10% of new model publishes across accounts; surface Console controls to beta customers
Phase 3 (GA): Default accept sidecar manifests for all new model publishes; backfill recent models with defaults and publish migration logs
Rollback plan: If regressions occur, use the rollback endpoint to restore previous pinned variant and write an incident note in the journal
